Loaded via the header ⛅ Climate button (shared with Energy). EnergyPlus EPW (primary) or Radiance WEA format.
NCC Section J▾
Open the full Section J workspace to configure DTS/J1V3 inputs, run checks and review results without using the narrow sidebar.
LEED v5 BD+C▾
Configure the New Construction energy-simulation pathway, generate a detached preliminary Appendix G baseline and review PI/PIt results.
Model Defaults▾
R and heat capacity are calculated from the ordered layers. Surface values come from the outside material; R excludes dynamic air films. Air-volume thickness defaults to 0 m; upper Roof and Interior Slab values deduct occupied construction from floor-finish-to-floor-finish zone geometry.
Select a preset assembly or create a project copy. Zone selections override these building-wide assemblies.

Scope▾
Energy runs model the WHOLE building (all zones, all levels) — EnergyPlus zones are thermal boundary conditions for each other and cannot be run one at a time (G-5).
